title: Composition opens as a list of video clips
given: A v3 composition has intro, proof, and outro clips.
when: The user opens the composition in the desktop editor.
then: The left panel lists the clips as video segments, not flat component tracks.

ai_tools.command: NEXTFRAME_HOME=examples target/debug/nf verify --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-clip-first | jq '.summary.clips'

ai_tools.expected: returns clip rows such as intro
